title: Great Zimbabwe

place.label: Great Zimbabwe, Masvingo Province, Zimbabwe
place.basis: official UNESCO World Heritage point; not a boundary
place.coords_source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre official point for Great Zimbabwe National Monument (World Heritage List 364), published as S20 16 16.212 E30 55 59.768 at https://whc.unesco.org/en/list/364/maps/ (table read 2026-11-27); approximate, not a boundary

tiers.everyday: Great Zimbabwe is a stone-walled city in southern Africa built by Shona people between about AD 1100 and 1450. Its traders were linked to goods from China and Persia.
tiers.student: UNESCO says Great Zimbabwe was built between AD 1100 and 1450 and founded in the 11th century by Bantu-speaking Shona people of the Iron Age; it held over 10,000 people in the 14th century and was abandoned around 1450. Beads of glass, and porcelain traced to China and to Persia, were found there. UNESCO states the site is unquestionably of Bantu origin; older stories giving it a foreign origin are legends. Inscribed 1986.

timeline.event: Inscribed on the World Heritage List
